question_text: Explain how a school can use network segmentation and OS security permissions to restrict students, staff and guests to appropriate resources.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves differentiated access reasoning under explicit segmentation plusOSsecurity; does not conflate authentication with authorization.
solution: Authenticate users and associate them with appropriate groups/roles.; Use VLANs/sub nets to separate guest, student and staff traffic.; Configure inter-segment access rules rather than allowing unrestricted reach ability.; Give students access only to appropriate learning/personal files.; Give staff only the sensitive-record permissions their roles require.; Keep guest devices from sensitive internal services; enforce file permissions even when a network path exists.

marking_points.criterion: Authenticate users and associate them with appropriate groups/roles.
Use VLANs/sub nets to separate guest, student and staff traffic.
Configure inter-segment access rules rather than allowing unrestricted reach ability.
Give students access only to appropriate learning/personal files.
Give staff only the sensitive-record permissions their roles require.
Keep guest devices from sensitive internal services; enforce file permissions even when a network path exists.
